blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Accounting is the language of Czarnikow's numbers. Today's lesson is "Receipts and Records". It gives you short, useful words for the finance team.

You will learn five words: record, folder, copy, file and box. You will also practise plurals: one record, two records; one box, two boxes. Go slowly. One step at a time.

Sophie helps new trainees. She uses short sentences and simple words. She asks you to repeat. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: What is today's lesson about?
items.why: "Today's lesson is 'Receipts and Records'."

items.q: How many new words will you learn?
items.why: "You will learn five words: record, folder, copy, file and box."

items.q: What is the plural of "box" in the text?
items.why: Palavras com -x fazem plural com -es: box → boxes.

items.q: The text suggests that Sophie's teaching is…
items.why: Inferência: "short sentences and simple words", "Go slowly. One step at a time."

items.q: "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts." This suggests the lesson wants you to feel…
items.why: Inferência: a frase é de incentivo — "You can do it!" — para dar confiança.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie apresentando o tema para um novo trainee. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, and welcome to the team. My name is Sophie. I work in accounting. Today I want to show you our receipts and records. Don't worry — it is easy. We go slowly, one step at a time.

Look at this desk. Here is a folder. In the folder there are two files. Each file has one copy of every receipt. When a file is full, we put it in a box. The box goes on the shelf.

At the end of every day, we check one thing: the record has to match the records. Same numbers, same date. If they match, we close the file. If they don't, we look again.

Please repeat after me: "record, folder, copy, file, box." Good! Now, when you are ready, leave the box on my desk. You did very well today. See you tomorrow.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where does Sophie work?
items.why: "My name is Sophie. I work in accounting."

items.q: What is inside the folder?
items.why: "In the folder there are two files."

items.q: When does the team put a file in a box?
items.why: "When a file is full, we put it in a box."

items.q: Why does Sophie say "Don't worry — it is easy"?
options: She wants the trainee to feel calm
items.why: Inferência: ela usa frases curtas e tranquiliza o trainee para dar confiança.

items.q: What can we understand about the trainee's first day?
options: The trainee did a good job
items.why: Inferência: "You did very well today. See you tomorrow."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The record has to match the records." A record is a…
items.why: Record = registro (uma anotação dos números).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please put the receipt in the new ___."
items.why: Folder = pasta, onde guardamos os documentos.

items.q: "The copy is ready for your signature." A copy is a…
items.why: Copy = cópia de um documento.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We check the ___ at the end of every day."
items.why: File = arquivo; é o que a equipe confere no fim do dia.

items.q: "Please leave the box on my desk." A box is a…
items.why: Box = caixa (guarda os arquivos cheios).

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que a equipe de contabilidade usa no dia a dia. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you fill in this form, please?" To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher (completar com informação).

items.q: "The boss will sign off on the report today." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "Please check the numbers before we close the file." To check the numbers means to…
items.why: Check the numbers = conferir se os números estão certos.

items.q: "The record has to match the records." To match means to…
items.why: Match = bater, ser igual (mesmos números).

items.q: "Let's go over the file one more time." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, passar por cima com atenção.
